agent: ministers wave, reader A: the tech minister (OpenHOI3 stage 5, 2026-10-16)
question: What CAITechMinister does on the exe's side (the monthly re-plan, the two bytes, slot 47), what every engine method TechMinister_Tick reaches answers, what CStartResearchCommand and CChangeLeadershipCommand do when they run, and which rand math.random is.

addresses.name: CAITechMinister::DoWork
addresses.comment: **Virtual slot 10 - the tech minister's tick, entered every AI pass (hourly) because it first sets countdown +0x30 = 1.** (1) The day of the month, counted from 0: days = (tick - 43800000) / 24; dayOfYear = days - (int)((float)(int)(days / 365.0) * 365.0); the month lengths at 0x1713294 are subtracted in turn. (2) **The re-plan**: when FolderModifers (+0x70..+0x74) or TechModifers (+0x60..+0x64) is empty, or last_day_of_month (+0x58, -1 from the constructor) > today's day of the month - true only on the first pass after a month turns - it calls CAITechMinister::RebuildTechModifiers (0x4AECA0, `push this`) then CAITechMinister::RebuildFolderModifiers (0x4AEF40, this in ECX); then +0x58 = today's day. (3) When `(country_id (+0x38) + 3) % 24 == (tick - 43800000) % 24`: GetThreadLuaState, Lua_TechMinister_Tick (the minister, &+0x5C, &+0x5D) and LuaCallProxy_TechMinister_CallVoid - **TechMinister_Tick(minister, vbSliders = byte +0x5C, vbResearch = byte +0x5D)**, inside a try that catches luabind::error and hands it to ReportLuaError (handler 0x8AEC7E, VA). Nothing in the exe reads the two vectors the re-plan fills (see RebuildTechModifiers). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ministers.md section A and reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ai.md.
addresses.revises: Names the two re-plan callees and the Lua call's two helpers, says which byte is which Lua argument (+0x5C is vbSliders, +0x5D vbResearch, off the pusher 0x4AF2E0's push order), and records the luabind::error catch. No earlier claim changed.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x8AEAD0..0x8AEC95 (VA): `mov [esi+0x30],1` at 0x8AEAF7; the empty tests `test edx,0xfffffffc` on +0x74-+0x70 (0x8AEBEB) and +0x64-+0x60 (0x8AEBF9), `cmp [esi+0x58],edi; jle` at 0x8AEC00; `push esi; call 0x8aeca0` then `mov ecx,esi; call 0x8aef40`; `lea ecx,[esi+0x5c]` / `lea eax,[esi+0x5d]; push eax` into 0x8AF280, whose frame stores ECX at +0x10 and the stack pointer at +0x14, and 0x8AF2E0 pushes byte [args+4] then byte [args+8] through lua_pushboolean (import 0xD2B534). ehcatches.py 0x8AEAD0: one try, .?AVerror@luabind@@. Would be wrong if 0x8AF2E0 pushed the stack argument first - it reads [ebx+4] before [ebx+8].

addresses.name: CAITechMinister::RebuildTechModifiers
addresses.comment: **The first half of the monthly re-plan: TechModifers (+0x60), one float per technology, from the units the country fields.** Resizes the array to (number of technologies + 1) and zeroes it; then for every unit on the owner country's units list (+0xBAC) and every regiment on the unit's list (+0x38), with d = the regiment's definition (+0x58): `size = max((float)(d->completion_size (+0xE4) / 1000.0), 1.0f)`, and for each technology T bearing on d (d->technologies +0x44..+0x48) **that CTechnology::CanResearch(T, this country, -1) allows**: `mods[T->Index] += (T->canUpgrade (+0x314) ? 1.0f : 0.3f) * size`, each sum done in double and stored as a float. Then the total (summed the same way): if total < 0.01 and total > -0.01 every entry is set to **0**; otherwise every entry is divided by the total (double, stored float), so they sum to 1. `this` is the one stack argument (`ret 4`). One caller, CAITechMinister::DoWork. **Nothing in the exe reads the result**: the two registered Lua getters GetTechModifers (0x4E90B0) and GetFolderModifers (0x4E90C0) are the only readers, and Their Finest Hour's scripts call neither. The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x8AECA0..0x8AEF3F (VA), `ret 4` at 0x8AEEF5 and 0x8AEF3C, `mov ebx,[ebp+8]` the minister. Constants read from the image: 0x171DBAC = 1.0f (floor and canUpgrade weight), 0x15C05EC = 0.3f, 0x160A300 = 1000.0, 0x160A378 = 0.01f, 0x160A788 = -0.01. The CanResearch call is `push -1; push [ebx+0x38]; push [ebx+0x34]; mov ecx,edi; call 0x535760` at 0x8AEDF8. Reader scan: every `reg <- [base+0x6C]` (the CEU3AI's tech minister) in a resumed sweep of .text followed within 12 instructions by `[reg+D]` - D = 0x60/0x64/0x70/0x74 give **0** hits while the positive control D = 0x5C/0x5D gives the 14 delegation writes in CreateMinisters and ApplyPlayerDelegation; findRefs finds no callers of the two getters and one registration reference each. The install's Lua: grep for 'Modifers' finds only BlackICE's files. Would be wrong if a CAITechMinister* reached the vectors through a path other than CEU3AI +0x6C or its own `this`.

addresses.name: CAITechMinister::RebuildFolderModifiers
addresses.comment: **The second half of the monthly re-plan: FolderModifers (+0x70), one float per technology folder.** Resized to (number of folders, technology database +0x3C..+0x40, + 1) and zeroed; then over the same units and regiments as RebuildTechModifiers, with the same `size = max(completion_size / 1000, 1.0f)`: for **every** technology T bearing on the regiment's definition - no CanResearch test here - `mods[T->Folder (+0x290)->Index (+0x5C)] += (T->canUpgrade ? 1.0f : 0.2f) * size`. Total under 0.01 (and over -0.01): every entry set to **1.0** (not 0, as the technology array is); otherwise each divided by the total. Bare `ret`, `this` in ECX. One caller, CAITechMinister::DoWork. Read by nothing in the exe (see RebuildTechModifiers). The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x8AEF40..0x8AF18F (VA): `mov edi,ecx` at 0x8AEF66, `lea esi,[edi+0x70]`; the size array from [db+0x40]-[db+0x3C] at 0x8AEFA3; the weight `movss xmm3,[0x171618c]` (fAiCommitmentFactor_0_2, 0.2f) against 1.0f on canUpgrade (0x8AF06F); the folder index `[edx+0x290]` then `[edx+0x5c]` at 0x8AF080; the small-total arm stores xmm2 = 1.0f (0x8AF120); bare `ret` at 0x8AF145 and 0x8AF18C. Would be wrong if [edx+0x290] were not the technology's folder - it is the luabind-named Folder field.

addresses.name: CAITechMinister::OnTechnologyLevelResearched
addresses.signature: void __thiscall CAITechMinister::OnTechnologyLevelResearched(CAITechMinister* this, CCountry* country, CTechnology* technology)
addresses.comment: **Virtual slot 47: a technology with more levels has just finished one, so the country's own tech minister takes it off the research queue.** Called only through AISubscribers_NotifyTechnologyResearched (0x4A3040) from the end of CDistributeResearch::Distribute, once for each finished technology whose additional_offset is not 0 - after Distribute has put it back at the end of CurrentResearch when its next level is allowed. If `country->id (+0xCA8) != this->country_id (+0x38)` it returns; otherwise it news 0x48 bytes, builds **CStopResearchCommand(this country, technology)** (0x157E00) and posts it on the session: in_game_screen slot 18, then its +0x38 channel's slot 6. The posted command removes the technology (CStopResearchCommand::Execute), so **an AI country, or a player who delegates research, never keeps a multi-level technology queued past a finished level** - its minister chooses again at its hour. Where the technology was not put back (its next level not allowed) the command fails IsValid and does nothing. Only the tech minister subscribes to that channel. `ret 8`.
addresses.revises: Was OnCountryEvent (likely) with the notification and its second argument not established. The notification is the end of a finished level in CDistributeResearch::Distribute, the argument is the CTechnology (EDI at 0x520E10 is the finished list's element), and the object 0x557E00 builds is a CStopResearchCommand, posted at once.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x8AE9B0: `cmp [ecx+0xca8],eax` with eax = this[+0x38], new(0x48), `call 0x557e00` whose body writes vftable 0x15C40F4 (RTTI CStopResearchCommand) at 0x557E7F and +0x3C/+0x40/+0x44 from its three arguments; post through [gamestate+0xBE8] slot 18 (+0x48) then [session+0x38] slot 6 (+0x18). Caller chain: 0x8A3040 is the only code holding the channel 0x1B14FE0 besides Enable/Disable (findRefs: 5 references, all in those three); it calls VcallThunk_Slot47 (0x522410, `mov eax,[ecx]; jmp [eax+0xBC]`) with `push edi; push ebx`, ebx = its stack argument; its one caller is 0x520E9D in CDistributeResearch::Distribute (slot 0, 0x51F620), where edi = [node] of the finished list (0x520E17) and the pushed argument = [frame+0x1C]+0x18, the country. Would be wrong if another code path called slot 47 directly: slotcalls.py 47 lists 240 sites, but every CAIAgent class holds the stub 0xA806D0 there except this one, and the channel is reached only by 0x8A3040.

addresses.name: CAITechMinister::Enable
addresses.comment: **Slot 52, the tech minister's own Enable.** `enabled (+0x3C) = 1`; appends a 0x10-byte node {this, prev, next, 0} to the CAISubscriber channel at 0x1B14FE0 (VA; head, tail 0x1B14FE4, count 0x1B14FE8) - the channel AISubscribers_NotifyTechnologyResearched walks, so this is what makes slot 47 fire; then `countdown (+0x30) = MT19937Next(&gamestate->+0x124) % 3 + 1` - one draw on the AI's generator, the same as CAIPoliticsMinister::Enable. Called through [vftable+0xD0] by CEU3AI::CreateMinisters and CEU3AI::ApplyPlayerDelegation right after construction. Bare `ret`.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x8AE880..0x8AE97C (VA): `mov byte [edi+0x3c],1`; the node build and `[0x1b14fe4]`/`[0x1b14fe8]`/`[0x1b14fe0]` stores; `lea eax,[esi+0x124]; call 0xaa2b90; cdq; idiv 3; inc edx; mov [edi+0x30],edx`. vtable.py --holding 0x8AE880: CAITechMinister slot 52 only. Would be wrong if 0xAA2B90 were not MT19937Next - it is recorded so.

addresses.name: CAITechMinister::DisableAndDisband
addresses.comment: Slot 49: finds this minister's node on the channel at 0x1B14FE0 (VA) and sets its target to null - the notifier unlinks such a node on its next walk - then tail-jumps to CAIAgent::DisableAndDisband (0x49C8A0). So a disabled tech minister hears no more finished technologies.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x8AE980..0x8AE9AA (VA): the walk `cmp [eax],ecx; ... mov eax,[eax+8]` from [0x1b14fe0], `mov dword [eax],0`, `jmp 0x89c8a0` on both paths. vtable.py --holding: CAITechMinister slot 49 only. Ends in a jmp, so there is no ret of its own to check.

addresses.name: CAITechMinister::ScalarDeletingDestructor
addresses.comment: Slot 0: writes the vftable back, frees FolderModifers (+0x70) and TechModifers (+0x60) and zeroes their three words each, runs the CAIAgent destructor 0x49C7C0, and frees the object when `flags & 1`. `ret 4`. The only other code that touches the two arrays besides the re-plan and the Lua getters.

addresses.name: CAITechMinister::CanResearch
addresses.comment: **Lua `minister:CanResearch(tech)`: may the country start this technology now.** True when (1) the technology's slot 9 answers true - CTechnology's is `mov al,1`, CNullTechnology's (`notech`, the database's first entry) `xor al,al`; (2) CTechnology::CanResearch(technology, the minister's country, -1) - the next level is a real level (a single-level technology, additional_offset 0, only level 1) not above max_level, and the technology's `allow` block holds for the country (and, in a custom game only, the custom settings' figure); and (3) the technology is **not already on the country's CurrentResearch** (+0x638), compared by pointer. Nothing else - not the number of slots, not the year. `ret 4`.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x8AF190..0x8AF1F5 (VA): `call [eax+0x24]` on the technology, `push -1; push [esi+0x38]; push [esi+0x34]; call 0x535760`, then the walk of [country+0x638] comparing `[eax]` with the technology and answering false on a match. vtable.py CTechnology CNullTechnology: slot 9 0xA92590 (`mov al,1`) and 0x592360. Registered as CAITechMinister:CanResearch (luabind.json).

addresses.name: Lua_TechMinister_Tick
addresses.signature: LuaCallFrame* __cdecl Lua_TechMinister_Tick(bool* vbResearch@stack:4, CAITechMinister** minister@EAX, bool* vbSliders@ECX, lua_State* L@EDI, LuaCallFrame* out@ESI) @EAX

addresses.name: AISubscribers_NotifyTechnologyResearched
addresses.comment: VA 0x8A3040 to the bare `ret` at 0x8A30C1. Walks the CAISubscriber channel at 0x1B14FE0 (g_AISubscriberList_TechResearched) and calls each subscriber's slot 47 (through VcallThunk_Slot47) with (country, technology); a node whose subscriber is null is unlinked and freed, or only marked (+0xC = 1) while [0x1B14FEC] is set. One caller, CDistributeResearch::Distribute at 0x520E9D, once per finished technology with more levels. Only CAITechMinister subscribes (its Enable), and only it overrides slot 47. The twin of AISubscribers_NotifyControllerChanged. The name is ours.

addresses.name: VcallThunk_Slot47
addresses.comment: MSVC's vcall thunk for slot 47 - `mov eax,[ecx]; jmp dword ptr [eax+0xBC]` - so the effective convention is the callee's (slot 47 of the CAISubscriber family, `ret 8`). Named class-free on purpose (trap 4). Called from AISubscribers_NotifyTechnologyResearched at 0x8A305A, the one call in .text.
addresses.evidence: image.findBytes(8B 01 FF A0 BC 00 00 00) answers 0x522410 alone (VA); vtable.py --holding: in no table; the call at 0x8A305A. Ends in a jmp, so there is no ret to check.

addresses.name: g_AISubscriberList_TechResearched
addresses.comment: CAISubscriber channel 0x22 of the table at VA 0x1B14DC0: a {head, tail (0x1B14FE4), count (0x1B14FE8)} list of 0x10-byte nodes {subscriber, prev, next, dead}, with the iterating byte at 0x1B14FEC. CAITechMinister::Enable appends to it, CAITechMinister::DisableAndDisband nulls its node, and AISubscribers_NotifyTechnologyResearched walks it - five references in the image, all in those three.
addresses.evidence: findRefs.py --address 0x1B14FE0: five references, at 0x8A304A, 0x8A3091, 0x8A3099 (the notifier), 0x8AE8E5 (Enable) and 0x8AE981 (slot 49). (0x1B14FE0 - 0x1B14DC0) / 16 = 0x22.

addresses.name: CEU3AI::CreateMinisters
addresses.comment: **Creates or destroys the five ministers, and the whole AI-delegation rule is here.** Bare `ret`, one caller: the tail of CEU3AI::CEU3AI at 0x888566. For each ministry: return outright when `gamestate[+0xD0C] != 0`; create unconditionally when this is not the played country (`this[+0x24] != gamestate[+0xC34]`); and when it is, create only when the local player delegates it, else destroy. So **an AI country always has all five, and the human's country has only the ones delegated**. The player's tests: foreign `GetLocalPlayer()[+0x38][0] == 1` (+0x60), production `[1]` (+0x64), espionage `[4]` (+0x68), politics `[3]` (+0x70) - **but the tech minister (+0x6C) is made when `GetLocalPlayer()[+0x30] != 0`**, the four-way value the save calls `automate_tech_sliders`, and for the player only its two bytes are then set from it: 1 gives vbSliders and vbResearch, 2 research only, 3 sliders only, anything else neither. **A country nobody plays keeps the constructor's 1 and 1.** Each new minister is enabled through slot 52 at once. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ai.md and reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ministers.md section A.
addresses.revises: The record had flags[2] as the player's tech test here. That is ApplyPlayerDelegation's test (0x889296, `cmp [ecx+8],1`); CreateMinisters tests +0x30 (0x888C6F) and then writes the two bytes from the same value, for the player only (the switch at 0x888D65 is reached only through the isPlayer arm at 0x888CE5).
addresses.evidence: The five calls of GetLocalPlayer (0x685F00) in 0x8888C0..0x888F2F, each followed by its test: `cmp [edx],1` (0x888988), `cmp [ecx+4],1` (0x888A80), `cmp [ecx+0x10],1` (0x888B79), `cmp [eax+0x30],ebx; je` (0x888C6F), `cmp [ecx+0xc],1` (0x888E27); the switch 0x888D6B..0x888DA3 stores into [[esi+0x6C]+0x5C]/[+0x5D]. The save Germany1936_04_20_03.hoi3 holds `automate_tech_sliders=1` as a number, not yes/no. Would be wrong if +0x30 and flags[2] were kept equal by whatever writes them - not read.

addresses.name: CStartResearchCommand::Execute
addresses.comment: **Puts the technology at the end of the country's research queue, and checks nothing.** country = the country database's countries[+0x40]; CCountry_AppendCurrentResearch(country, technology) - a new node at the tail of CurrentResearch (+0x638/+0x63C, count +0x640). Then, the count being at least 1, LeadershipDistribution[3] slot 4 - CDistributeResearch::ShareAmongProjects - so the projects' shares of leadership are worked out again at once. Nothing is told to the player. Bare `ret`.

addresses.name: CChangeLeadershipCommand::CChangeLeadershipCommand
addresses.signature: CChangeLeadershipCommand* __stdcall CChangeLeadershipCommand::CChangeLeadershipCommand(CChangeLeadershipCommand* this, float officers, float diplomacy, float espionage, float research, CCountryTag tag)
addresses.comment: **The four leadership shares from four floats - the Lua constructor's path.** Type token 0x4A0, vftable 0x15C4074, tag +0x3C/+0x40, an empty vector of 64-bit shares at +0x44/+0x48/+0x4C. Each float below 0 (or NaN) becomes 0. `sum = (float)((double)officers + diplomacy + espionage + research)`. Then for each in that order: `q = (float)((double)x / sum)`; **share = (__int64)(q * 32768.0 + (q >= 0 ? 0.5 : -0.5))**, truncated by _ftol2 - fixed 15 rounded half away from zero - pushed onto the vector. Nothing else is clamped; four shares that came from fractions summing to 1 sum to 32768 give or take a unit of rounding. A sum of 0 gives 0/0. `ret 0x1C`. One caller, LuaConstruct_CChangeLeadershipCommand.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x557330..0x5575A7 (VA): the four `comiss x,0; ja` clamps at 0x5573D1..0x557405, the double sum and `cvtpd2ps` at 0x55742A, per share `divsd` then `cvtpd2ps`, the 0.5 / -0.5 choice (0x160A308 = 0.5, 0x160A350 = -0.5 read from the image), `fmul [0x160a348]` (32768.0), `fadd`, `call 0xc088a6` (_ftol2), `call 0x422690` the push; `ret 0x1c`. Measured: the 20 April 1936 save has ENG at `0.20001 0.07999 0.03000 0.69000`, which is 6554, 2621, 983 and 22610 over 32768 - exactly 0.2, 0.08, 0.03 and 0.69 (the script's answer for ENG) through this rounding.

addresses.comment: The technology screen's path: `values` is a vector of four 64-bit fixed-15 slider values. `sum` = their 64-bit total, and each share is `(value << 15) / sum` by __alldiv - **truncated**, so the four shares sum to 32768 or a little less. Reads entries 0 to 3 whatever the vector's length. `ret 0x10`. One caller, CTechnologyView::SendDistribution (0x81D3A9), which builds the values from the sliders' positions (each rounded half away from zero to fixed 15 and the running total held to 0x320000) and sends nothing while the player's automate_tech_sliders value is 1 or 3.

SendDistribution 0x81D150: GetLocalPlayer()[+0x30] `dec eax; je` and `sub eax,2; je` to the exit at 0x81D3E2, the 0x320000 caps at 0x81D30B/0x81D339. Order officers, diplomacy, espionage, research - so Lua's (nco, diplomacy, espionage, research). No test of anything, and IsValid (slot 14) is the shared `mov al,1`. Last, for the local player's country only (gamestate +0xC34), in_game_screen slot 94 (+0x178) with 0 - a refresh of the screen. Bare `ret`.

addresses.name: CTechnologyView::SendDistribution
addresses.comment: The technology screen's counterpart of CProductionView::SendDistribution: called from Update at most once a wall-clock second when a slider changed. **It sends nothing while the local player's automate_tech_sliders value (GetLocalPlayer +0x30) is 1 or 3** - the tech minister then owns the sliders. addresses.name: CCountry::GetInfluencedCountryCount
addresses.comment: **Lua `CCountry:CalculateNumberOfActiveInfluences()` - how many countries this one is influencing now.** No stack arguments, plain `ret`, the country in ecx. Walks every country o of the database (+0x168 count, +0x16C array, in id order) and counts those whose o->+0xE28[this->+0xCA8] has influence_running (+0x2C) set - the CInfluence a running influence leaves on the influenced country's side - the same flag the daily influence upkeep charges for. The tech minister's BalanceLeadershipSliders sets a major's diplomacy share to this count over its total leadership when it holds more than 50 influence. Abuts CCountry::ChangeNeutrality, which starts at 0x4FBF80 after eight int3. (First recorded at rva 0xFBF00, which is inside this function rather than its start - 0xFBF80 is CCountry::ChangeNeutrality, so 0xFBF00 could not begin anything. The start is 0xFBEA0, preceded by int3 padding, `push ebp; mov ebp, esp; and esp, -8`. buildFindings.py dropped the entry until this was corrected.)
addresses.revises: likely -> confirmed: the body read whole and the direction settled - CDiplomacyStatus +0x2C is carried on the influenced side (influenced->diplomacy[influencer]), so o->+0xE28[this] counts the countries this one influences. It is the registered CCountry:CalculateNumberOfActiveInfluences (luabind.json). Name kept.
